agency.name: Division of Substance Abuse and Mental Health (DSAMH), Delaware Department of Health and Social Services

countyDirectory.name: Help Is Here Delaware — official treatment & resource finder

narrAffiliate.name: First State Alliance of Recovery Residences (FSARR)

narrNote: FSARR appears on NARR's official affiliate list; its site was opened and content-verified in-run.
notes: Delaware has only 3 counties and no county behavioral-health authority layer; DSAMH is the single state layer, so the state's official Help Is Here finder serves as the local-resource directory. The DMMA Medicaid page (verified in-run) confirms Medicaid covers mental-health and substance-abuse services; SUD coverage (including IMD services and contingency management) runs under the Diamond State Health Plan 1115 demonstration, CMS-extended through Dec 31, 2028. Regional DSAMH crisis lines also operate alongside the Hope Line: Northern DE 800-652-2929, Southern DE 800-345-6785.
